evd_title: Overall CONSORT compliance rose from 27.3 percent in 1966-1990 to 56.1 percent in 2010-2024 across 21041 RCTs
finding: Overall CONSORT compliance rose from 27.3 percent in 1966-1990 to 56.1 percent in 2010-2024 across 21041 RCTs
P: 21,041 open-access human RCT full texts from PubMed (of 53,137), medicine; high-confidence subset; periods n=2,771/1,969/3,765/10,447
I: GPT-4o-mini (Azure), zero-shot, one prompt per CONSORT criterion over full text (PDF->XML); 21 of 25 items; high-confidence only
